items.heading: Most "AI
items.text: Most "AI-proof careers" content stays abstract: judgment, creativity, empathy. That is true, but it does not tell you what to actually study, apply for, or specialize in next.

items.heading: These Roles Combine Physical Assessment
items.text: These roles combine physical assessment with a level of trust a patient or family will not extend to a screen. India's healthcare workforce gap is not a future risk; it is a current, measurable shortage.

items.heading: Every Trade Below Involves Diagnosing
items.text: Every trade below involves diagnosing a physical problem inside a space that is never quite standard. That variability is precisely what current robotics and AI struggle with, even as software gets better at diagnostics and scheduling around the trade.
